organization.name: Saved by the Plate Inc.
organization.description: Empowering individuals to make informed food choices by connecting them to local food sources and sustainable agriculture education. We provide youth education programs in food justice, composting, and urban agriculture across New York City.

website.name: Saved by the Plate Inc.
website.description: Connecting communities with sustainable food options and local agriculture, starting with our youth.

education_page._implementation: Add via <Helmet> from react-helmet-async inside the Education component

educational_organization.name: Saved by the Plate Inc. — Youth Education Programs
educational_organization.description: Customizable youth education programs exploring food justice, sustainability, community gardens, composting, and environmental science for students of all ages.

course_community_gardens.name: Community Gardens & Food Justice
course_community_gardens.description: Explore food justice, food sovereignty, community gardens, and urban agriculture in New York City. A 6-week customizable program for youth covering the history and impact of urban gardens, sustainable growing strategies, biodiversity, and environmental advocacy.

syllabusSections.name: Week 1: History of Community Gardens
syllabusSections.description: Uncover the rich legacies of urban gardens and their pivotal role in NYC's food justice movements

syllabusSections.name: Week 2: Community Gardens Today
syllabusSections.description: Investigate the current state of gardens across NYC and their impacts on neighborhoods

syllabusSections.name: Week 3: Urban Growing Strategies
syllabusSections.description: Practice composting, urban planting, and other sustainable techniques for city environments

syllabusSections.name: Week 4: Urban Biodiversity & Environmental Benefits
syllabusSections.description: Explore how gardens support biodiversity, reduce heat island effect, and improve air quality

syllabusSections.name: Week 5: Guest Speaker
syllabusSections.description: Bring in a guest speaker who works in a community garden to talk about their experience

syllabusSections.name: Week 6: Environmental Justice & Community Gardens
syllabusSections.description: Examine the intersection of urban agriculture, equity, and environmental advocacy

course_soil_science.name: Composting, Soil Science & Sustainability
course_soil_science.description: Learn about food waste, composting, soil nutrients, and the organisms that make soil alive. A 6-week youth program covering food waste reduction, composting fundamentals, soil health, micro and macro nutrients, and soil ecosystems.

syllabusSections.name: Week 1: Understanding Food Waste
syllabusSections.description: Explore the scale of food waste in our communities and its environmental impact

syllabusSections.name: Week 2: Composting Fundamentals
syllabusSections.description: Learn the science behind composting and how to turn food scraps into nutrient-rich soil

syllabusSections.name: Week 3: Soil Nutrients & Health
syllabusSections.description: Discover the essential nutrients plants need and how to build healthy, productive soil

syllabusSections.name: Week 4: Micro & Macro Nutrients
syllabusSections.description: Deep dive into the role of nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium, and micronutrients in plant growth

syllabusSections.name: Week 5: Guest Speaker
syllabusSections.description: Hear from a composting or soil science expert about real-world applications

syllabusSections.name: Week 6: Soil Organisms & Ecosystems
syllabusSections.description: Explore the fascinating world of bacteria, fungi, earthworms, and other organisms that make soil alive
